main.description: Delete the caller's attachment reference at this blinded index; when no reference to the blob remains, its object becomes eligible for chat object GC again. Idempotent. ORF endpoint ([CB-17]): states are per device of the caller DID; the server never reveals one. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.

deviceKeyPubkey.description: The device whose ORF state maps the index.
